newsitem.title: CANADA: Gold stocks trading heavily on recent news.
newsitem.headline: Gold stocks trading heavily on recent news.

text.p: A handful of gold companies topped Toronto's most actives list Tuesday morning, trading heavily on recent news despite directionless gold bullion prices.
More than 630,000 shares of NovaGold Resources Inc changed hands in the first hours of trading, pushing the company's stock up C$.08 to C$0.38.
The company said last week that its joint venture partner, Chapleau Resources Ltd, reported encouraging drill results at NovaGold's zinc, lead and copper property in north central New Brunswick.
